title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET far outside the slow-down range asks for full speed and, dead on target, lowers frustration
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (pulse laser, weaponRange 12500, max speed 320) at accuracy 2 in ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET with frustration 0.5 and success_factor 0.5 against a stationary ship dead ahead at range 20000. slow_down_range = weaponRange * COMBAT_WEAPON_RANGE_FACTOR = 15000 (4648) and 20000 is above it, so the far branch applies: desired_speed = max(maxFlightSpeed, min(3 * target_speed, max_available_speed)) = max(320, min(0, 320)) = 320 (4683). trackPrimaryTarget finds the target on the nose (d_forward 1 above the aim cosine), returns 1 and sets no stick; success_factor = 1 is above 0.999, so frustration -= dt: fround(0.5 - 1/120) (4690-4693). No event; behaviour unchanged.

title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET toward a target straight above commands full pitch up and raises frustration
derivation: Same ship (max_flight_pitch 1.4), initial frustration 0.5 and success_factor 0.5, stationary target straight above at (0, 20080, 0): range 20000, far branch, desired_speed 320. trackPrimaryTarget at accuracy 2: d_up 1, d_forward 0, d_right 0: stick_pitch = -max_flight_pitch * 0.125 * 8 = -1.4 (9196-9204), and since the ship is turning it returns d_forward = 0, so success_factor = 0: not above 0.999 and not above last_success_factor 0.5, so frustration += dt: fround(0.5 + 1/120) (4694-4695), well under the 3 s limit.

title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET at range 4000 with a target flying at 100 m/s sets desired speed 105
derivation: A Mamba-like ship at accuracy 2 in ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET, success_factor 0.5, against a ship dead ahead at range 4000 moving at 100 m/s (the speed field; the pose is static): range 4000 is inside slow_down_range 15000 and back_off_range 10000 * 0.5 = 5000 (4648-4657); accuracy 2 is below COMBAT_AI_IS_SMART (4658), and accuracy is below 6, so desired_speed = max(1.05 * 100, 0.25 * 320) = 105 (4663). The target is on the nose, so trackPrimaryTarget returns 1: no stick, success_factor 1, frustration 0 stays 0 (the decrement clamps at 0, 4691-4693).

title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET inside COMBAT_IN_RANGE_FACTOR x weaponRange switches to ATTACK_TARGET, and the dispatcher then breaks off to fly-from
derivation: A Mamba-like ship at accuracy 2 in ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET against a stationary ship dead ahead at range 300. range < COMBAT_IN_RANGE_FACTOR * weaponRange = 0.035 * 12500 = 437.5 (4630) and there is no proximity alert (the self-test keeps every body outside four radii), so behaviour = ATTACK_TARGET (4632). The rest of the call still runs: desired_speed = max(1.05 * 0, 0.25 * 320) = 80 (4663), target on the nose, frustration stays 0. On tick 2 the dispatcher runs on the same pose (the ship moves at most 0.02 m): nearby (range 300 < 437.5, 4128), accuracy 2 below 6, pitching_over false, so two ranrot draws (scripted [0.7, 0.3]: jink.x 179, jink.y -180, 4148, 8985-8999) and ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET (4154). jink.z depends on the relative speed after one update of the ship's own thrust, so only the draw-derived jink.x and jink.y are checked. Draws consumed: 2.

title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET with 3 s of frustration posts shipAIFrustrated, draws a 1000-jink and returns to ATTACK_TARGET
derivation: A Mamba-like ship at accuracy 2 with frustration 2.999 (rounded to float32, 2.99899983...) and success_factor 0.5 in ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET against a stationary ship straight above at range 20000. The ship is turning, so success_factor = 0: not above 0.999 and not above 0.5, so frustration += dt (4695): fround(2.999 + 1/120) = 3.00733 > 3 (4696). That posts shipAIFrustrated (noteFrustration, 4698), calls setEvasiveJink(1000) (two ranrot draws, scripted [0.7, 0.3]: jink (179, -180, 1000), 4699), sets ATTACK_TARGET, frustration 0 and desired_speed = maxFlightSpeed (4700-4702). The far branch had set desired_speed 320 already. Draws consumed: 2.

title: ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET past 10 s of frustration: the 0.3 draw raises desired speed, the z draw leaves the jink z, the jink pair is redrawn and frustration halves
derivation: A Mamba-like ship at accuracy 2 in ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET with frustration 9.999 (float32) and success_factor 3005 against a stationary ship at range 3000: success_factor becomes 3000 and last_success_factor 3005 is above it, so the target counts as closing and frustration += dt (4743-4745): fround(9.999 + 1/120) = 10.00733 > 10 (4750). Draws in order: randf() u1 = 0.2 < 0.3 sets desired_speed = maxFlightSpeed * 1 (no fuel injection, 4751-4752), and the else-if is skipped, so it takes no draw; randf() u2 = 0.9 is not below 0.3, so z stays jink.z = 900 (4756-4760); setEvasiveJink(900) draws [0.7, 0.3]: jink (179, -180, 900) (4761); frustration /= 2 (4763): fround(10.00733 / 2) = 5.0037. desired_speed 320 is neither above max nor below half of it (4765-4773). Exit test: range 3000 > 0.5 * 12500 + 15 * 179 = 8935 is false and flightSpeed 0 is not above (25600 - 3000) * 1.4 / 6.28, so the ship stays in ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET. Draws consumed: 4.

title: ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET past 10 s of frustration: a high first draw tries the 0.3 return to ATTACK_TARGET, the z draw halves jink z and sets desired speed from flightSpeed
derivation: Same ship and pose as the previous row but flying forward at 50 m/s, jink.z 900 and scripted draws [0.5, 0.1, 0.2, 0.7, 0.3]. After frustration crosses 10: randf() u1 = 0.5 is not below 0.3, so the else-if tests range 3000 > COMBAT_IN_RANGE_FACTOR * weaponRange = 437.5 (true) and draws u2 = 0.1 < 0.3: behaviour = ATTACK_TARGET (4753-4754). Then randf() u3 = 0.2 < 0.3: z = 900 / 2 = 450 and desired_speed = flightSpeed * 2 = 100 (4757-4760); setEvasiveJink(450) draws [0.7, 0.3]: jink (179, -180, 450); frustration halves. desired_speed 100 is below 0.5 * 320 = 160, so it is reset to maxFlightSpeed 320 (4771-4773). The exit test is false (3000 < 8935). The last behaviour written is ATTACK_TARGET. Draws consumed: 5.

title: ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET beyond COMBAT_OUT_RANGE_FACTOR x weaponRange with zero jink returns to ATTACK_TARGET
derivation: A Mamba-like ship at accuracy 2 in ATTACK_FLY_FROM_TARGET with zero jink against a stationary ship at range 7000. The exit test range > COMBAT_OUT_RANGE_FACTOR * weaponRange + 15 * jink.x = 0.5 * 12500 + 0 = 6250 is true (4775): jink zeroed, ATTACK_TARGET, frustration 0 (4776-4778). success_factor = 7000. desired_speed 0 is below 160, so it was raised to 320 first (4771-4773).

title: ATTACK_FLY_TO_TARGET_SIX heads for the point 0.5 x weaponRange behind the target and stays in SIX while far
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (pulse laser, weaponRange 12500) at accuracy 2 against a stationary ship (nose pointing away, aspect -1, speed 0) 8000 m ahead, with pitching_over initially set. behaviour_fly_to_target_six runs the non-turret branch (the `forward_weapon_type isTurretLaser` tests at 4537 and 4565 are false). success_factor takes the distance to the ship's PREVIOUS destination (4500-4501) and every row here makes it exceed last_success_factor, so the `||` at 4559 never needs trackDestination's confidence factor (that function and its sticks belong to plan 14-01's reference, so no stick is checked). pitching_over is cleared (4556). Previous destination (0, 0, 3000): distance 3000, success_factor 0 -> 3000 so frustration += dt (4559-4560). range 8000 is inside slow_down_range 15000 (4503) and beyond back_off_range 0.5 * 12500 = 6250, so desired_speed = max(1.2 * 0, 320) = 320 (4507); range 8000 is not below 0.5 * distance = 1500, so it stays SIX. distance 3000 is not below 750 and the standstill test (target_speed < 0.2 && (universalID & 14) > 4) is false for id 101 (101 & 14 = 4, not above 4). The destination is distance_six(0.5 * 12500) = target position - 6250 * target forward = (0, 0, 8080 - 6250) = (0, 0, 1830). The aspect -1 and frustration 0.0083 do not trigger the 4565 return.
